projectArchiveExport: Export the entire project as ZIP
projectArchiveExportDescription: Save local files, tasks, deliverables and their histories in a portable archive. Remote connections are included without their secrets or files remaining on those servers. Wait for ongoing operations to finish before exporting.
projectArchiveSensitive: The ZIP may contain confidential documents and conversations. It is not encrypted: store it securely.
projectArchiveDownloadError: Unable to download the project archive. Check your connection.
projectArchiveImportDescription: The ZIP is checked before anything is created. Import creates a new project and never replaces an existing one.
projectArchiveLimit: Current limits: 96 MiB ZIP, 1 GiB uncompressed and 20,000 files. Encrypted archives are not supported.
projectArchiveImportError: Import failed. Select the ZIP again to retry.
projectArchiveImporting: Restoring the new project… Do not close this window.
projectArchiveSafety: Agents and automations do not start. External connections must be reconfigured: their secrets are not transferred.
projectArchiveContacts: Imported contacts are inactive and are not automatically linked to accounts on this installation. Their original contact details remain in the project's provenance.
projectArchiveExpiry: This analysis is valid for 15 minutes. Compatibility is checked again on confirmation.
projectArchiveSelection: What would you like to import?
projectArchiveCore: Always included: project information, participants, groups and workspace configuration. Contacts remain inactive.
projectArchiveBundleFiles: Files and folders from all workspaces
projectArchiveBundleConversations: Agents and conversations, including histories and attachments
projectArchiveBundleWork: Complete project activity: tasks, deliverables, documents and versions, automations, knowledge and journal
projectArchiveRequired: Automatically included: required by a selected category.
projectArchiveDependencies: Project activity includes conversations and files; conversations include files. Linked data stays together, without per-document selection. Uncheck dependent categories first. The size above refers to the complete ZIP.
